erf_basic_module:
Option VBASupport 1

Function gerf(F#) As Double
  G# = Abs(F)
  T# = 1# / (1# + 0.5 * G#)
  Answer# = T# * (-1.13520398 + T# * (1.48851587 + T# * (-0.82215223 + T# * 0.17087277)))
  Answer# = T# * (0.09678418 + T# * (-0.18628806 + T# * (0.27886807 + Answer#)))
  Answer# = (T# * Exp(-G# * G# - 1.26551223 + T# * (1.00002368 + T# * (0.37409196 + Answer#))))
  If F# >= 0# Then gerf = 1# - Answer# Else gerf = -1# + Answer#

End Function

Function gerfC(F#) As Double

    gerfC = 1# - gerf(F#)

End Function
